action_items: Fix program_signup priority window: include priority_until in db.programs.find_one projection (server.py:3225) so _with_seats correctly reports full during the 48h claim priority window. Suggested patch: remove the projection or add 'priority_until': 1 to the fields dict so the 'public signup during priority window -> waitlist' spec is honored.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~5082 lines (up from ~4877 last iter). Cloning + forecast history + badge wall + appeal comparison all land in one monolith -- split into routers (clone, forecast_history, badge_wall, appeal_reports) before the file crosses 6k lines.

program_signup selectively projects program fields but _with_seats depends on priority_until -- the two helpers have an implicit coupling that is not asserted. Either drop the projection in all seat-dependent callers or make _with_seats fail loudly when priority_until key is absent.

_transfer_waitlist awaits _spot_email synchronously inside a request handler (admin_update_program); for a 50-person waitlist that's 50 serial SMTP calls blocking the response. Wrap in BackgroundTasks or asyncio.gather with concurrency cap.
_CLONE_SKIP tuple hardcodes field names that could silently drift from ProgramIn/_clean_program; consider deriving skip-list from a canonical ProgramIn.model_fields set.

appeal_comparison aggregation only joins on appeal_id for segment_emails; donations with campaign/UTM but no appeal_id (e.g., manual donations attributed via source) are not counted. Document or widen the match.

yir row recipients formula uses sum((sent if status=='done' else recipients) or 0 for x in logs) -- summing across multiple yir_emails with same year double-counts if the admin re-sends. Dedup to last/completed run per year.

ForecastHistory 'Close season' uses window.prompt for label (per spec) -- fine, but prompt() returning empty string also triggers close-season which saves 'Season ending <Mon YYYY>' default; make the dialog an inline input + Cancel to prevent accidental double-close.

Admin UI relies on clicking admin-view-* tabs rather than deep links (/admin/programs returns 'No routes matched'). If the review spec says 'Admin → Programs/Reports' the surface is correct; however documentation + QA tooling should mention there is no deep-link path.

Public GET /api/programs/{slug} returns full:true while POST signup accepts the seat -- this inconsistency is a usability + fairness bug (first users see 'full' banner yet backend takes their seat if they bypass the banner).
